answer: Each key must return a randomly selected serialized reusable beverage crate at a certified deposit kiosk. The kiosk verifies its weight, signs a one-use receipt carrying the zenith/canyon/nadir nonce, and the registry consumes that serial; duplicate receipts or out-of-range weights trigger rejection. Proposed handling fee: .65 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .65 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,650 (1,000 × .65) in fees. Limitation: kiosks are unevenly available and operators could collude.
